sections: Images 1 to 5. The whole argument for a visitor who looks at nothing else: each image a different system, screenshots large, almost no notes.
Stage 0. Every run passes through these.
Stage 1. What nearly every player touches in every run, and what they complain about most.
Stage 2. Bags and containers, food, books, TV and radio, sleep.
Stage 3. The map, barricades, crafting, and the first car.
Stages 4 and 5. Only long runs get here.
For the pad and Steam Deck player. Pitch image 2 points here.
Themes, styles, and what you can turn off. Then multiplayer and uploading.
